ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a predominantly high-intensity white surface (estimated 65% area) bifurcated and outlined by low-intensity black margins and internal linear disruptions (estimated 35% area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white fields occupy the central medial and distal regions of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped along the entire trailing edge and terminal tips, with a triangular dark region at the peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, symmetric V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel-based interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes; left lobe trailing edge displays three prominent jagged peaks, while the right lobe presents a sequence of shallow, repetitive semi-circular indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric progression from a concave curve at the medial notch transitioning to a broad convex arc reaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, textured circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal points of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly dense network of unaligned, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crisscrossing the high-intensity white fields on both lobes, with primary trajectories along the transverse axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring across the ventral surface and heavy calcified parasitic colonization (barnacles) resulting in structural alteration of the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular focal point (pigmentation spot or healed lesion) located on the upper-left lobe near the distal margin.
